title: CISA KEV +10: Mitel MiCollab, Danfoss ICS, HPE Juniper, Vates Xen Orchestra
sum: CISA added 10 actively-exploited CVEs to KEV: 4 Mitel MiCollab (arbitrary file upload, XML injection, weak auth, OS command injection), 3 Danfoss AK-SM 800A ICS controllers (path traversal, input validation, auth bypass), 1 HPE Juniper Session Smart (OS command injection) and 1 Vates Xen Orchestra (input validation). Exploited as zero-days in suspected AI-assisted attacks; federal agencies must patch by Dec 9.
ctl: M1051 Update Software — patch Mitel/Danfoss/HPE/Vates before the Dec 9 deadline
M1016 Vulnerability Scanning — confirm no exposed vulnerable versions
M1030 Network Segmentation — isolate Danfoss ICS controllers from IT

title: Drupal Fail2Install (CVE-2026-132165, CVSS 9.8) — pre-auth RCE, KEV-added
sum: Critical pre-auth RCE in Drupal core 8.9-11: attackers exhaust server resources to trick the installer into allowing reinstallation, create an admin account, and drop a PHP payload via a SQLite .php file. Confirmed exploited on live sites since Nov 19 and added to KEV Nov 24 with a Dec 9 patch deadline.
ctl: M1051 Update Software — patch Drupal core immediately
M1042 Disable or Remove Feature or Program — block the installer post-provisioning
M1016 Vulnerability Scanning — sweep for exposed Drupal installs

title: ASP.NET Idunno.AntiCsrf (CVE-2026-131914, CVSS 9.3) — abandoned-library RCE
sum: Critical insecure deserialization in the abandoned 2008 ASP.NET anti-CSRF library Idunno.AntiCsrf; a single unauthenticated HTTP POST achieves RCE in the IIS worker process. Actively exploited per Google Cloud/Mandiant IR; the library has no patch.
ctl: M1042 Disable or Remove Feature or Program — remove Idunno.AntiCsrf.dll (0.9.1.0)
M1016 Vulnerability Scanning — locate any WebForms apps referencing the library
M1038 Execution Prevention — block post-deserialization code execution

title: Microsoft Outlook NTLM leak (CVE-2026-124194) — exploited zero-day
sum: Actively-exploited Outlook zero-day leaks NTLMv2 hashes when a victim opens a crafted message file. Patched in the Nov 10 Patch Tuesday, but exploitation is confirmed in the wild.
act: Windows endpoints with outstanding November updates
ctl: M1051 Update Software — apply November Office security updates
M1037 Filter Network Traffic — block unnecessary outbound SMB
M1043 Credential Access Protection — mitigate NTLM relay of leaked hashes

title: 1Password compromised via employee GitHub account — source code and customer data stolen
sum: An attacker compromised an employee's corporate GitHub account, stole private source code, pushed malicious code to backend services, and siphoned customer names, emails, account identifiers and timestamps. No vaults, passwords or secrets were accessed; investigation began Nov 19 and was disclosed Nov 26.
ctl: M1032 Multi-factor Authentication — enforce phishing-resistant MFA on GitHub accounts
M1018 User Account Management — review and rotate compromised accounts/tokens
M1047 Audit — monitor backend services and customer-records access

title: GitHub supply-chain campaign — malicious workflow files exfiltrate CI/CD secrets
sum: An ongoing malicious-workflow campaign has compromised tens of thousands of GitHub repositories (including Uber-owned ones), injecting workflow files to exfiltrate CI/CD secrets. Previously reported and still unfolding.
act: GitHub repositories (tens of thousands, incl. Uber-owned)
ctl: M1016 Vulnerability Scanning — scan repos for malicious workflow files
M1035 Limit Access to Resource Over Network — restrict CI/CD secret scope
M1047 Audit — review pipeline secret usage and rotation

title: Inception ransomware claims Restaurant Brands International — 234GB stolen
sum: Inception ransomware group claims to have stolen 234GB / 800K files from Restaurant Brands International (Burger King, Tim Hortons, Popeyes, Firehouse Subs), including 126K Burger King US customer records and 216K ServiceNow incident folders. Claims posted Nov 26 to a leak site with a Nov 27 deadline; unverified.
act: Restaurant Brands International (Burger King, Tim Hortons, Popeyes, Firehouse Subs)
ctl: M1053 Data Backup — verify offline recoverability
M1041 Encrypt Sensitive Information — protect guest/customer PII
M1019 Threat Intelligence Program — monitor for leaked-data phishing campaigns

title: US Treasury FinCEN and CIA/spy agencies breached — systems taken offline
sum: FinCEN took systems offline after detecting unauthorized access (no evidence of BSA or beneficial-ownership database compromise), while the CIA and other spy agencies separately suffered breaches exposing unclassified information — hackers allegedly using the Chinese-made Artex AI tool. FBI and CISA are involved.
ctl: M1026 Privileged Account Management — harden administrative access to bureau systems
M1032 Multi-factor Authentication — enforce on all government accounts
M1019 Threat Intelligence Program — track Artex-linked actor activity

title: Flight Centre data breach via third-party accommodation system
sum: A third-party accommodation booking system was accessed, exposing names, basic travel info and, in rare cases, limited passport details, DOB and health info for Flight Centre, Travel Associates and Cruiseabout customers. No card/payment data was accessed.
act: Flight Centre, Travel Associates, Cruiseabout customers
ctl: M1018 User Account Management — review third-party system access
M1041 Encrypt Sensitive Information — protect travel/passport data
M1022 Restrict File & Directory Permissions — limit bulk booking-data access

title: Zodia Custody breach — Standard Chartered crypto unit B2B API exposed
sum: Standard Chartered's crypto custody unit detected probing on Nov 23 and took its B2B API offline; client organisation details, names and email addresses were exposed. No unauthorized transactions occurred, and affected clients and regulators were notified.
ctl: M1035 Limit Access to Resource Over Network — restrict B2B API exposure
M1032 Multi-factor Authentication — enforce on API access
M1047 Audit — review API access logs for exfiltration

title: myColorado digital ID app shut down after unauthorized data access
sum: Colorado's digital ID app was shut down after unauthorized data access potentially affecting 50K–150K residents; the app remains offline during the holiday travel period.
ctl: M1041 Encrypt Sensitive Information — protect state resident PII
M1032 Multi-factor Authentication — secure app access on restore
M1018 User Account Management — scope affected accounts

title: Bithumb breach worse than reported — 19 data types incl. passports and bank accounts
sum: A follow-up probe of Bithumb's October breach found 19 exposed data types — passports, bank accounts, wallet addresses and ID copies — worse than initially reported, across a 15-day access window.
ctl: M1057 Data Loss Prevention — contain exposed credential/PII spread
M1026 Privileged Account Management — review exchange-side accounts
M1041 Encrypt Sensitive Information — protect KYC/payment data

title: Switzerland confirms first autonomous AI-agent cyberattacks on critical infrastructure
sum: Switzerland's NCSC confirmed 5 AI-assisted intrusions against critical infrastructure and companies in at least 2 sectors, where AI agents autonomously scanned for vulnerabilities, selected tools, evaluated results and executed next steps. Publicly-available AI hacking agents nearly doubled since Oct 2026.
act: Swiss critical infrastructure and companies (2+ sectors)
ctl: M1019 Threat Intelligence Program — track autonomous-agent TTPs
M1040 Behavior Prevention on Endpoint — detect automated intrusion
M1016 Vulnerability Scanning — close the AI-scanned exposure first

title: Google GTIG: autonomous AI exploit agents cross a significant threshold
sum: Google/Mandiant found threat actors using multi-agent frameworks (ARTEX, CAIRN, CyberStrikeAI, PentAGI) to patch-diff, generate and execute exploits within hours of disclosure, 'trading stealth for velocity.' A public staging server exposed an exploit_agent framework alongside stolen data.
ctl: M1051 Update Software — reduce the patch-to-exploit window
M1019 Threat Intelligence Program — track agentic exploit activity
M1016 Vulnerability Scanning — pre-empt agent-driven exploitation

title: Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938) — OpenJDK RCE with working exploits, patch unclear
sum: An OpenJDK RCE vulnerability with working exploits available via VulnCheck and independently developed by researchers. Patch status unclear — watch for CISA KEV addition.
ctl: M1051 Update Software — apply OpenJDK patch when available
M1016 Vulnerability Scanning — inventory exposed Java runtimes
M1040 Behavior Prevention on Endpoint — detect exploitation attempts
